model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира точността на различни модели върху три набора от данни: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос показва категориите на данните, подредени в произволен ред без определена скала. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Точност (%)" и показва стойности от 50 до 62 с интервал от 2, използвайки линейна скала. Диаграмата представя шест групи стълби, всяка от които е оцветена според легендата: DAPO+Self-reflection (синьо), DAPO (синьо-сиви ивици), SRPO (оранжево), GRPO (оранжево-зелени ивици), PPO+Self-reflection (зелено) и PPO (зелено-сиви ивици). За Mathverse, стълбите варират приблизително между 52% и 56%; за MMLU, те са между 54% и 57%; а за Physics, те достигат между 54% и 61%. Някои стълби са визуално подчертани със своето оцветяване според групите в легендата.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph presents a comparison of the accuracy percentages across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, for multiple methods or models. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50 to 62, with increments of 2. The graph features grouped bars for each category, with each group consisting of bars representing DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO, distinguished by different colors and patterns. In Mathverse, the bars are approximately 56, 54, 55, 54, 54, and 54, respectively. For MMLU, the values are around 56, 54, 56, 55, 55, and 55, respectively. In Physics, the bars show values of approximately 61, 57, 60, 57, 58, and 58, respectively. The bars are arranged in a specific order based on the legend provided, but no particular sorting or emphasis is applied within each category.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists these categories, with no apparent order or scale, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62 in increments of 2. The chart features six methods: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO, each represented by a distinct color and pattern. For Mathverse, the approximate accuracy percentages are: DAPO+Self-reflection around 56%, SRPO around 55%, DAPO and GRPO around 54%, PPO+Self-reflection around 53%, and PPO around 52.5%. For MMLU, the values are: DAPO+Self-reflection around 56.5%, SRPO and GRPO around 55%, DAPO around 54.5%, PPO+Self-reflection around 54%, and PPO around 53.5%. For Physics, the values are: DAPO+Self-reflection around 61%, SRPO around 59%, GRPO around 58%, DAPO around 57%, PPO+Self-reflection around 58%, and PPO around 57.5%. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern distinctions.
model_annotations.German: This bar graph presents accuracy percentages across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents accuracy percentages, ranging from 50 to 62%, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals. Each category contains seven bars, representing DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (light blue), SRPO (orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (green), PPO (light green), and an unspecified category is not present, with DAPO and PPO represented by solid fill and diagonal stripes, while SRPO, GRPO, DAPO+Self-reflection and PPO+Self-reflection have a solid fill. The bars are not sorted in any specific order within each category. Approximate accuracy percentages for selected bars are as follows: for Mathverse, the highest bar, DAPO+Self-reflection, is around 56%, and the lowest, PPO, is about 53%; for MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 56%, and PPO is around 54%; for Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection is at about 61%, and PPO is around 58%.
